summary_1line: Bharata humbly halts his army and proceeds on foot to seek Rama’s forest hermitage, sending scouts to locate his exiled brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Bharata leaves his vast army camped far from Chitrakuta and walks alone on foot toward the forest to meet Rama.
A massive army of elephants, horses, and warriors spreads across the plains while the forested slopes of Chitrakuta rise in the distance.
Bharata instructs Shatrughna and hunters to search the dense forest for Rama’s hermitage while Guha stands ready with armed warriors.
